contracts.semanticAction: ReplaceGeneralTextRangeV1 is a separately named documented Rust action and private versioned journal entry, not an added branch in the original public Command enum. Preparation retains conditional origins and fresh definitions outside Undo, verifies that visible content is unchanged, then applies all causal writes in one native history span before complete final admission and native-preview equality.
contracts.recovery: Explicit general_checkpoint/general_typing_checkpoint and restore_general/restore_general_typing pair only with their own families. Original readers reject new saves; general readers do not silently upgrade original saves. Original model11/12/13 and journal12/13/14 bindings remain intact for rich language1/2/3.
contracts.naturalHistory: Selected first-key replacement starts its own group; following same-caret/style input may join under existing time and step rules. It never joins preceding input. Empty input does not delete a selection; line separators isolate continuation. Exact restart retains original selection and complete grouped future history.
contracts.bounds: Native expanded work must fit the existing transaction operation limit. The original command batch remains capped at64. Inserted text retains the1000-run and64KiB bounds, and unchanged whole-journal, causal-view, document and transport budgets still apply. No temporary user blocks, increased node ceilings, copied surviving text or shared root register are used.
contracts.authority: Stale/read-only, invalid styles/IDs, historical ID reuse, invalid final content and late failures reject without changing the live owner, its frame, selection, pending formats or stacks. Current host permissions are not persisted authority.

writerTransport.reproduction: A valid semantic edit exported237 identical operations as two changes on its author and one coalesced change after binary import. Original version-one lineage hashed those change boundaries and refused the canonical digest. The exact flattened operation arrays were equal.
writerTransport.originalVersion: Frozen. Original formatVersion1 lineage, group and batch meanings and strict refusal behavior are unchanged; this checkpoint does not claim V1 transport is repaired by normalization.
writerTransport.additiveVersion: Explicit writer_clock_v2, writer_groups_v2_guarded and prepare_writer_group_v2 select formatVersion2. Recursively sorted JSON records are prefixed with unsigned big-endian u64 byte lengths. Ordered atoms retain operation author/counter, container, payload, Lamport clock and immediate causal frontier; engine change/run packing, commit messages and wall clocks are excluded. Single deletes normalize their direction.
writerTransport.integrity: Payload hashes, authenticated author/range, room/schema/model/engine bindings, dependencies, fork/duplicate checks, original byte limits, complete semantic admission and exact observation-fenced publication remain mandatory. V1 and V2 APIs reject each other's envelopes. Receipt/clock values belong to the explicit transport context in which they were obtained.
writerTransport.proof: Every sliced interval of a pinned-engine fixture matches the engine's own singleton exporter, including Unicode, list inserts, forward/reverse deletion, map, marks, movable-list and tree ops. An independently generated Node SHA-256 vector freezes the V2 bytes. Mutated payloads, positions, clocks, dependencies, containers and bindings change the digest or reject.
writerTransport.relayAdmission: The repaired semantic group stages without publication on an original-history receiver. Duplicate delivery is a no-op. Four Undo/Redo groups retain equal documents and V2 lineage through exact server reload. Authentication, fork, payload, missing-dependency, wrong-version and stale-preparation regressions pass.
